text:
erin: Quick sync — planning a cohorted unpin for runtime 2.25 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Kernel reorder + kv-cache pointer patch. We want a staggered rollout by customer cohort (A/B/C) and a short pinback window for sensitive models.

tomas: Can we define cohort A = internal + alpha partners, B = mid-tier customers, C = public? We'll run canaries in A for 30m before moving to B.

asha: Canary (eu-west) looks ok overall but p95 +8% for quant-longseq at tiny batch sizes. No 5xx. I'll attach traces to the PR.

leo: Request: add emergency re-pin for safety-ltr/* and policy-models/* in case we see safety drift. Those models must never unpin without explicit approval.

pm-beth: From PM side, flagging two customers in cohort B who requested embedding stability. Recommend we keep embed-pro/* pinned to 2.24 for 6h after cohort move.

ops-oncall: Propose deadman revert at 05:00 UTC. Auto-revert criteria: 5xx rate > 1% OR p95 increase > 20% sustained 8m OR safety metric delta > +1.5% absolute. Page release leads on trigger.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist for roll 2.25 at 01:30 UTC. Diff preview below:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.24 -> models: [assistant-core/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.25 -> models: [fast-sampler/*]
+ cohort_unpin: cohort=A -> runtime:2.25 (start 02:00 UTC)
+ cohort_unpin: cohort=B -> runtime:2.25 (start 02:40 UTC)
+ cohort_unpin: cohort=C -> runtime:2.25 (start 03:20 UTC)
+ emergency_hold: [safety-ltr/*, policy-models/*]  # require manual approval
+ soft_pinback: embed-pro/* -> runtime:2.24 until 08:00 UTC for cohort=B
```

erin: Decision: proceed with cohorted rollout + soft pinback for embed-pro/* on cohort B only. Action items:
- asha: publish canary repro and attach traces by 01:00 UTC.
- tomas: run the cohort A smoke at 02:00 and report within 30m.
- leo: keep the emergency_hold list enforced and be ready to approve/unpin if safe.
- pm-beth: notify the two cohort-B customers and have CS on standby.
- deploybot: apply snapshot at 01:30 and publish final pin diff to /releases/2.25/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 05:00 UTC and watch safety signals.

asha: Minimal repro: `prompt = "summarize very long doc with 8k context"` — warmup latency visible first 15 tokens on quant-longseq. Flamegraph + traces in PR.

tomas: I'll kick off cohort A smoke at 02:00 UTC and post results. If it looks good after 30m, proceed to B.

leo: Locking emergency_hold for safety-ltr/* and policy-models/* now. DMing security for quick review if needed.

pm-beth: Sending customer notes to CS now. Draft: "We'll be rolling runtime 2.25 for cohorts; embed-pro models in cohort B will remain on 2.24 for 6 hours to avoid transient performance variance." DMing the two contacts.

ops-oncall: Deadman revert thresholds set. If triggered, deploybot will auto-apply previous pinlist and post a revert snapshot to #release-ops and page leads.

deploybot: Confirmed: snapshot applied at 01:30 UTC. Pin diff published to /releases/2.25/pins snapshot_id=pin-4012345678-01. Logs will stream to /infra/deploys.

erin: Reminder: if any safety or correctness regressions show up in cohort A canary, tag me immediately and pause the rollout. We'll hold any further unpins for cohort B/C until we hit 06:00 UTC.

tomas: Cohort A smoke: 02:00-02:30 done. No 5xx, p95 within +6% except the known quant-longseq warmup spike. Proceeding to cohort B at 02:40.

asha: Follow-up: traced kv_refresh latency for batch_size=1; filing INF-5202. Not blocking but should be tracked post-roll.

leo: Security sanity check complete — no safety drift in cohort A. Holding approval for policy-models/* until we get more sampling in B.

deploybot: Automated: cohort B unpin started 02:40 UTC. soft_pinback for embed-pro/* enforced for cohort B until 08:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: Monitoring live. If auto-revert triggers, teams will be paged. Running targeted smoke for the two customer pipelines now.

pm-beth: CS acknowledged receipt and will monitor customer reports. Thanks everyone.

erin: Roll notes: we'll reconvene in #release-ops at 03:50 UTC for post-rollcheck. If all good, we'll schedule full unpin for cohort C at 03:20 and lift soft pinback for embed-pro/* after 08:00 as planned. :white_check_mark:
